verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents syncs that run on a schedule, a trigger, or when data changes. Its change data capture sends only added, changed, and removed rows, which covers audience members entering and exiting. Destinations include Braze and ad platforms, and the reverse-ETL page claims real-time syncing to 300+ destinations. missing for 10: documented near-real-time latency for audience membership changes specifically, explicit continuous or streaming audience sync to ad platforms, independent or hands-on corroboration of sync freshness.

support.subject: As a marketer, audiences sync to ad platforms and engagement tools continuously, with membership entering and exiting in near-real-time

citations.quote: A sync runs on the schedule or trigger you set
on a schedule or when data changes
send only the rows that were added, changed, or removed
Sync to 300\+ destinations in real-time or on a recurring schedule.
Help ad platforms recognize more of your customers by adding additional identifiers to synced audiences and conversions.
